gaps: the decisive step tests something else than the case's point: The setup cannot create an event-level vendor decline (H02) before the participate request.
The vendor read-back cannot assert user_intent.intent_type equals trade_accept because that field is not available in the read_event vocabulary.
The buyer audience read-back cannot verify that the decline text remains or that the new row has no company_id because the audience response shape is not sampled.
The request response cannot be asserted as HTTP 200 because act-step response assertions are not expressible.
